PORT SAINT NICHOLAS TERMINAL HARVEST AREA TROLL FISHERY

The Port Saint Nicholas Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial salmon troll fishery will open for the harvest of Chinook, coho, chum, sockeye, and pink salmon from 12:01 a.m., Monday, June 1, through 11:59 p.m., Friday, July 31, 2026, unless closed by emergency order. The spring troll advisory announcement published Friday May 29, inadvertently stated the waters of the Port Saint Nicholas (PSN) Special Harvest Area (SHA) would remain closed in 2026, similar to previous years. However, as announced in the PSN THA advisory announcement dated April 15, the waters of the Port Saint Nicholas Special Harvest Area (SHA) east of 133°02.92′ W long will open in 2026 to common property troll fisheries from June 1 through July 31. See the PSN THA announcement for further information.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
